---
title: "Relative Port Risk Summation"
output: html_document
---

## Purpose: To summarize the port and state data into a singular measure of relative risk per port

# gather n dogs
```{r load-parameters}
library(here)
library(dplyr)

source("src/utils/parameters.R")
n_dogs
opened_ports

state_to_port_final <- readRDS(here("data", "processed", "state_to_port_final.rds"))
glimpse(state_to_port_final)
```
```{r identify-risk-columns-for-downstream-functions}
# Identify the various risk columns I want to use for the assignment of risk chunks
#risk_columns <- c("nws_prevalence_from_state","at_risk_cattle_port_estimate","at_risk_cattle_state_estimate")

#identify by searching for name
risk_columns <- names(state_to_port_final |> dplyr::select(
    any_of(
        c(starts_with("nws"),
        starts_with("at_risk_cattle")
        ))))
```

# summarize columns by year and port
```{r summarize-relative-port-risk}
relative_port_risk <- state_to_port_final |>
    group_by(port, year) |>
    summarise(across(all_of(risk_columns), ~sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") |>
    arrange(desc(at_risk_cattle_port_estimate)) |> 
     ungroup()

```


# assign n_dogs as risk chunks
```{r }
#retrieve the risk chunk assignment function
source("src/assign_dogs.R")

risk_chunk_results <- assign_risk_chunks(
    data = relative_port_risk,
    risk_columns = risk_columns,
    total_chunks = n_dogs,
    by_year = TRUE
)

#save data
saveRDS(risk_chunk_results, here("data", "processed", "risk_chunk_results.rds"))
write.csv(risk_chunk_results, here("data", "processed", "risk_chunk_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(risk_chunk_results, here("outputs", "tables", "risk_chunk_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```


```{r evaluate-outcomes}
# Build and save an HTML summary of chunk assignment counts.
html_escape <- function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)
    x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
    x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
    x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
    x
}

build_table_html <- function(df, digits = 3) {
    if (nrow(df) == 0) {
        return("<p>No rows to display.</p>")
    }

    display_df <- df
    for (col in names(display_df)) {
        if (is.numeric(display_df[[col]])) {
            display_df[[col]] <- format(round(display_df[[col]], digits = digits), nsmall = 0, trim = TRUE)
        }
    }

    header <- paste0("<tr>", paste0("<th>", html_escape(names(display_df)), "</th>", collapse = ""), "</tr>")
    rows <- apply(display_df, 1, function(row_vals) {
        paste0("<tr>", paste0("<td>", html_escape(row_vals), "</td>", collapse = ""), "</tr>")
    })

    paste0("<table>", header, paste0(rows, collapse = ""), "</table>")
}

safe_file_name <- function(x) {
    gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", x)
}

# Pick one risk column output for downstream plotting/saving when needed.
relative_port_risk_chunks <- risk_chunk_results[["at_risk_cattle_port_estimate"]]

summary_sections <- lapply(names(risk_chunk_results), function(risk_name) {
    risk_df <- risk_chunk_results[[risk_name]]

    plot_file <- paste0("relative_port_risk_chunk_counts_", safe_file_name(risk_name), ".png")
    plot_path <- here("outputs", "report", plot_file)

    if ("year" %in% names(risk_df) && dplyr::n_distinct(risk_df$year) > 1) {
        plot_obj <- ggplot2::ggplot(
            risk_df,
            ggplot2::aes(x = chunks_assigned, y = stats::reorder(port, chunks_assigned))
        ) +
            ggplot2::geom_col(fill = "#1f78b4") +
            ggplot2::facet_wrap(~year, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
            ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, n_dogs)) +
            ggplot2::labs(
                title = paste("Chunks Assigned by Port -", risk_name),
                x = "n dogs (chunks assigned)",
                y = "port"
            ) +
            ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 11)

        plot_height <- max(7, 3.2 * dplyr::n_distinct(risk_df$year))
    } else {
        plot_obj <- ggplot2::ggplot(
            risk_df,
            ggplot2::aes(x = chunks_assigned, y = stats::reorder(port, chunks_assigned))
        ) +
            ggplot2::geom_col(fill = "#1f78b4") +
            ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, n_dogs)) +
            ggplot2::labs(
                title = paste("Chunks Assigned by Port -", risk_name),
                x = "n dogs (chunks assigned)",
                y = "port"
            ) +
            ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 11)

        plot_height <- 7
    }

    ggplot2::ggsave(
        filename = plot_path,
        plot = plot_obj,
        width = 11,
        height = plot_height,
        dpi = 160
    )

    by_year <- risk_df |>
        dplyr::group_by(year) |>
        dplyr::summarise(
            total_chunks_assigned = sum(chunks_assigned, na.rm = TRUE),
            ports_with_chunks = sum(chunks_assigned > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_ports = dplyr::n_distinct(port),
            .groups = "drop"
        ) |>
        dplyr::arrange(year)

    totals <- risk_df |>
        dplyr::summarise(
            total_rows = dplyr::n(),
            total_years = dplyr::n_distinct(year),
            total_ports = dplyr::n_distinct(port),
            rows_with_chunks = sum(chunks_assigned > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_chunks_assigned = sum(chunks_assigned, na.rm = TRUE)
        )

    paste0(
        "<section>",
        "<h2>", html_escape(risk_name), "</h2>",
        "<h3>Chunks by port</h3>",
        "<img src='", html_escape(plot_file), "' alt='Chunks assigned by port plot' style='max-width:100%;height:auto;border:1px solid #d1d5db;' />",
        "<h3>Overall counts</h3>",
        build_table_html(totals),
        "<h3>Counts by year</h3>",
        build_table_html(by_year),
        "</section>"
    )
})

report_path <- here("outputs", "report", "relative_port_risk_chunk_counts.html")

report_html <- paste0(
    "<!doctype html>",
    "<html><head><meta charset='utf-8'><title>Relative Port Risk Chunk Counts</title>",
    "<style>",
    "body{font-family:Segoe UI,Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif;margin:24px;line-height:1.4;color:#1f2937;}",
    "h1{margin-bottom:8px;} h2{margin-top:28px;} h3{margin:10px 0 6px;}",
    "p.meta{color:#4b5563;margin-top:0;}",
    "table{border-collapse:collapse;margin:8px 0 18px;min-width:560px;}",
    "th,td{border:1px solid #d1d5db;padding:6px 10px;text-align:left;}",
    "th{background:#f3f4f6;font-weight:600;}",
    "section{padding-top:4px;border-top:1px solid #e5e7eb;}",
    "</style></head><body>",
    "<h1>Relative Port Risk Chunk Counts</h1>",
    "<p class='meta'>Generated on ", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "</p>",
    "<p class='meta'>Configured chunks (n_dogs): ", html_escape(n_dogs), "</p>",
    paste0(summary_sections, collapse = ""),
    "</body></html>"
)

writeLines(report_html, report_path, useBytes = TRUE)
message("Wrote report: ", report_path)

names(risk_chunk_results)
glimpse(relative_port_risk_chunks)
```
